description: Privacy-focused Firewall and Package Manager for Android devices De1984 is a Firewall and Package Manager for Android that works with or without root. The name De1984 comes from George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four. It stands for resisting surveillance and taking back control of your device and data. FIREWALL FEATURES - Four firewall methods: iptables (root, or Shizuku in root mode), ConnectivityManager (Shizuku, Android 13+), NetworkPolicyManager (Shizuku, chosen manually) and VPN (no root, works everywhere). Picked automatically for your device. iptables blocks at kernel level - On ROMs without POLICY_REJECT_ALL, NetworkPolicyManager only blocks metered background data, not WiFi - Block WiFi, Mobile Data and Roaming separately with iptables and VPN (Roaming is part of Mobile Data). ConnectivityManager and NetworkPolicyManager block an app on all networks or none - Block LAN access, enforced only by iptables - "Block All by Default" (allowlist) or "Allow All by Default" (blocklist). Switching resets every app's WiFi, Mobile, Roaming and LAN rules to the new default, with no confirmation. System-recommended apps keep theirs, and critical and VPN apps keep theirs only while "Allow Firewall Critical Packages" is on - Captive portal settings (root or Shizuku). They stay changed after De1984 is uninstalled - Screen-off blocking to save battery and data - Rules follow network changes in real time PACKAGE MANAGEMENT (Shizuku or root) - Enable or disable system apps, force stop apps, uninstall system and user apps - Filter by system/user and enabled/disabled, and search PRIVACY FIRST - No tracking, analytics or telemetry - Local-only data storage - No proprietary libraries, no Google Play Services - 100% open source (MIT License), buildable from source REQUIREMENTS - Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher PERMISSIONS - ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE: apply rules per network - BIND_VPN_SERVICE: the VPN firewall - QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: list installed apps - POST_NOTIFICATIONS (optional): new app installs - RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED: start the firewall after a reboot, if it was on - FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE: keep the firewall running - REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS (optional): stop Android killing the firewall - KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES: last fallback for force stop - Shizuku API: talk to Shizuku or Sui - INTERACT_ACROSS_USERS: read apps in other profiles. When one exists, De1984 grants it to itself through root or Shizuku, without asking - WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS, CHANGE_COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE: only checked, to show status - REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES, INSTALL_SHORTCUT, ACCESS_SUPERUSER: declared, not used - Root or Shizuku (optional): the iptables, ConnectivityManager and NetworkPolicyManager firewalls, package management, boot protection and captive portal settings OPEN SOURCE Source code: https://github.com/dorumrr/de1984 Issues: https://github.com/dorumrr/de1984/issues Late nights for brighter days. Created by Doru Moraru
